comparison.objective: Loosen bottle caps and load bottles into an autoclave; candidate loosens a setscrew, tunes a damper, and relocks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Cap twisting and basket handling versus recessed-key manipulation, counterholding, fine collar rotation, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Caps at least 60 degrees loose before insertion; the available body lacks a complete final scoring rubric. Candidate requires quantified dynamic stopping and witness-torque retention.
comparison.reason: Shared loosen-before-operation sequencing is generic; the physical mechanisms and evaluated outcomes differ.
